messages:
marta ivanova: heads-up: during the latest model rollout a handful of SLOs lit up with short noisy bursts. wondering if console should offer a 'playbook preview' that recommends temporary suppression knobs (soft-snooze, fingerprint merge, route-attenuation) and shows estimated alert delta before apply.
samir patel: big yes to preview. must show "what would have happened" if rule applied historically. owner trust comes from replay numbers not fuzzy claims.
jun li: telemetry needs: per-route alert count timeline, unique-fingerprint ratio, alert-latency histogram, and incident-window clustering. without those the preview will be meaningless.
olivia king: UX: prefer a compact card on SLO detail with three tabs: Preview (numbers), Rules (what will change), Audit (who can approve/apply). CTAs: [Run Replay] [Open Playground] [Request Auto-Apply].
marta ivanova: to avoid human risk, default to preview-only and require explicit approval to persist rules. also include an 'impact estimate' like "suppressed alerts/hr" and "missed-escals (%)" with confidence band.
samir patel: API side: need endpoints for creating a dry-run suggestion and for requesting a historical replay job. something like POST /api/v1/slo/:id/playbook-suggestions and POST /api/v1/replays with payload referencing the suggestion id. responses should return a job id and summary.
jun li: add RBAC: only SLO owners and ops-admins can apply. team level roles should be able to request replays but not apply. audit log must record diffs.
olivia king: banner copy idea: "Surge detected for this SLO during rollout. Preview recommended playbook items to reduce noise. Review replay results before applying." small note: don't use the word 'suppress' in top line.
marta ivanova: sketch of suggestion payload (for infra):
```json
{
  "slo_id": "slo-9887",
  "suggestion_type": "playbook_preview",
  "rules": [
    {"action": "soft_snooze", "duration_mins": 45, "scope": "route:write-requests"},
    {"action": "fingerprint_merge", "threshold": 0.6}
  ],
  "meta": {"detected_by": "rollout_monitor", "evidence_sample": ["evt-aaa","evt-bbb"]}
}
```
samir patel: thank you — ensure meta.confidence is included in the real schema. UI will show a colored confidence pill.
jun li: replay design note: replays must be bounded (max 30d / capped events) and provide per-rule breakdown: alerts prevented, incidents prevented, false-positive marker inferred. also show traffic overlap with quotas to avoid accidental quota backpressure.
olivia king: can we surface estimated cost delta for applying rules? e.g., fewer pages = ops-hours saved. owners care about costs too.
marta ivanova: yes, add estimated ops-hours saved / week as a heuristic. not exact, but helps decision.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: playbook-preview service deployed to staging on Thu 02:15 UTC :hourglass_flowing_sand:
samir patel: next steps: i’ll draft the API schema + RBAC doc, jun will scope replay infra + cost estimates, olivia will mock the 3-tab card, marta will write the async RFC. cc: @oncall for potential interactions with alert routing.
jun li: one more edge-case: multi-tenant routes that share a downstream silo. playbook rules might need tenant-scoped exceptions. call that out in the RFC.
marta ivanova: noted. I'll include a small section on tenant overrides and quota interactions. thanks all.
